Anthropic says its MCP interface standard now tops 700 million monthly downloads two years after launch.

To help Claude work more independently, the company is expanding the protocol with new features. Updates include background tasks, follow-up questions for users, and file uploads.

Would you let an AI agent handle tasks in the background, or do you prefer manual control?
